svg.text: Four-Case Composed Latency Ladder (NVIDIA B200, Measured)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 1 (Config): Live config reconfig 3.70-5.15 ms to applied (7 vLLM models, up to 491.1 GiB TP4)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 2 (Python): Live code swap 57.9-92.0 ms to installed (0.6B-65.5 GB TP1 & 491.1 GiB TP4)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 3 (Graphs): Selective graph recapture 0.62-3.69 s to installed (full 166-graph MoE: 10.52 s)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 4 (Crash): 0.31-1.86 s Shadow or 2.73-6.96 s 0.6B/GMS+CRIU to ready -> 58-91 ms swap

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (Plain CRIU scales with weight size; GMS shrinks 14B/65.5 GB ckpts 4.81x-9.67x on vLLM & SGLang.)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: [2] 65.5 GB tier uses deterministic dummy BF16 weights (32.76B Qwen3ForCausalLM). Correctness: logprobs=5 max_abs_diff == 0.0 (vLLM & SGLang) and 3/3 bit-exact (TRT-LLM).

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: [3] SGLang 14B GMS+CRIU uses a local non-pauseable torch.cuda.graph shim + SglangLab decode-graph override (52 decode graphs ON, prefill graphs disabled vs. breakable on Plain).
